text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Here it is! It's finally here, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The once-in-a-lifetime, make-or-break 
gamble for 'O Sole Mio begins!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I must challenge them with all of my heart 
and soul. Against Grass, and against 
Suzuka-senpai!

The venue is completely packed to 
capacity. The fans' excitement is almost 
hard to believe for a GII.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, please lend El your strength! 
Who is the strongest Umamusume!?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Who is the Umamusume you believe in with 
all your heart?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Who is the sole Umamusume to leave 
Suzuka-senpai far behind and surge onward 
to the Japan Cup!?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Bueno! Let's head to the paddock!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Suzuka-senpai, thank you for today! I... 
I...!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"I'm planning to go somewhere I can look 
down on the whole world, yes! Higher than 
the sky you're aiming for!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... I'm counting on you, then. Even 
so...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm not... aiming for anything. I just 
want to see a scenery where no one else 
is...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El, that is our opponent. She does not see 
things from our level.

Even so, the course and distance are the 
exact same. Before this massive crowd, 
only a single outcome will be revealed!
